items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Builds how the geometry of a state was recorded (method, device, software, coordinate system, markers, fixtures) as JSON for CreateComponentSnapshot / CreateComponentIdentity. Markers and fixtures (a scanning rig) are never part of the geometry of the component itself.
